jobs.title: Part-Time GIS Developer - Federal Contract (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
Cloudnet Systems LLC, a small business federal IT contractor (GSA Multiple Award Schedule holder), is assembling the delivery team for a US Fish and Wildlife Service web platform support and improvement contract we are actively bidding. We are seeking a part\-time GIS Developer to join the proposed team.

**Compensation:** $60 per hour (1099 or W2 hourly depending on arrangement), paid for hours worked.

**What you will do:**

\- Support geospatial data alignment for a national wildlife refuge platform: hunt\-unit boundary analysis and correction, spatial data QA, and synchronization with an annually published authoritative feature layer.

\- Work with ArcGIS Online feature layers, related tables, and public and authorized REST APIs under a federal agency's ArcGIS organization (collaborator account provided).

\- Integrate spatial data and map views into web modules (Angular front end); support species\-to\-hunt\-unit data relationships feeding an annual federal rulemaking cycle.

\- Provide elevated GIS support during the January\-May rulemaking season, including boundary corrections and spatial layer reliability.

\- Coordinate with the agency's GIS advisory committee and data stewards on authoritative data layers.

**Role\-specific qualifications:** At least 3 years with the Esri platform, ArcGIS Online strongly preferred; feature services and REST APIs; spatial data quality workflows. Experience with federal or state natural\-resource GIS data a plus.

**The engagement:** approximately 240 hours in year one, then approximately 120 hours per year in subsequent option years spread as steady part\-time work, not a single block. Fully remote from anywhere in the United States, during Eastern business hours (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET). No on\-call or after\-hours work, including for critical incidents. One annual planning trip to Fort Collins, CO or Falls Church, VA may be requested for lead personnel. A Government laptop is provided.

**Important \- contingent role:** This position is contingent upon contract award, expected in fall 2026\. Selected candidates will be named in our proposal and must provide a one\-page resume and sign a brief letter of commitment by Wednesday, September 23, 2026\. There is no obligation and no work performed unless the contract is awarded. Candidates must be able to complete a federal background investigation and PIV credentialing before system access.

**General requirements:** US\-based and working on US soil; Bachelors degree plus at least 3 years of relevant experience (required by our GSA contract); federal contracting experience a plus.

**To apply:** send your resume with "GIS Developer \- FWS" in the subject line. We are moving quickly; qualified respondents will receive a 15\-minute screening call within one business day.

Pay: $55\.00 \- $60\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
